name: DurationInput
tagline: Duration Input replaces a plain number box for "how long" fields.
description: Duration Input replaces a plain number box for "how long" fields. Instead of working out that one and three-quarter hours is 105 minutes, people simply type 1h 45m, 1.75h, 105 or 1:45 — or tap a quick-pick chip such as 30m or 2h. The control saves the right number in the background (minutes, hours or working days) and always shows it back in a friendly format.
